LESSON: LIGHT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Natural Environment
Topic 2.3: Light
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Light, part of Natural Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we conserve light energy in our environment? 2. Why should we conserve light energy in our environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Light together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Unity: learner develops cooperation skills as they manipulate objects to form shadows in the presence.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social economic issues: Learner develops financial skills when practising switching off lights when not in use and during day time.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Posters on energy conservation relate to writing skills in Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Approved support learning materials, flash cards, braille cards, pictures of different sources of light, digital devices with assistive technology,

torch, transparent and opaque materials, candles.
